items.description: This research identified exploratory physical activity (PA) thresholds associated with symptom severity in older adults with Parkinson's disease and assessed their association with cardiometabolic and cognitive health. items.description: CONCLUSION: Administration of the NDV-H5 vaccine via oculonasal and oral routes elicited antibody responses, reduced viral shedding, and limited contact transmission in Mandarin ducks. items.description: IMPORTANCE: Graft choice remains a central controversy in primary anterior cruciate ligament reconstruction (ACLR). Quadriceps tendon (QT) and hamstring tendon (HT) autografts may provided similar clinical outcomes but differ in donor-site morbidity and postoperative strength recovery.

items.title: Poly-d,l-lactic Acid for Hip Tightening
items.description: CONCLUSIONS: PDLLA-HA injection for hip sagging was associated with clinician-rated photographic aesthetic improvement in this small retrospective series. These findings do not establish objective tissue tightening. Prospective studies with standardized assessment intervals, objective measurements, and longer follow-up are needed to evaluate efficacy, durability, and delayed adverse events.

items.title: A location-based serious game in museum learning: a comparative field study of visitor experience, motivation, cognitive load, and objective learning outcomes
items.description: INTRODUCTION: This study compared three museum visiting modalities-natural visits, audio guides, and a location-based serious game-in relation to visitor experience, motivation, cognitive load, and objective learning outcomes. Although serious games have increasingly been used in cultural heritage and museum education, less is known about how location-based serious games perform when compared with common visiting modalities in authentic museum settings.
